notes.title: Update 1.4.10 Local Mode now available!
notes.content:
Features:

-          A new way to play. Now users can play local matches. Upon signing into your account, you will see an option for “Local Mode”. With Local matches the board will automatically switch from White to Black allowing the users to play on the same computer. All Local matches are saved on the computer in which the game is played. Each account can save up to 3 matches at a time.
 

-          Miscellaneous bug fixes

We are constantly looking at ways to improve Regimental Chess. Please feel free to send us any bugs, suggestions or comments to info@regimentalchess.com.

To stay informed with the latest news and updates, follows us on Facebook .

notes.title: Update Version 1.2.9 – Time is a ticking!
notes.content:
With this new update, we have made changes to the way the game is played. Players will now be limited to a total of 3 matches at any given time. Timers have now been implemented during each players turn. If the time expires and the player has not completed all their moves, the game will skip that player’s turns. The amount of time given in a match is relative to the number of boards.

 [list]

[*]1 Board gives 2 minutes

[*]2 Board gives 2.5 minutes

[*]3 Board gives 3 minutes

[*]4 Board gives 3.5 minutes

[*]5 Board gives 4 minutes

[*]6 Board gives 4.5 minutes

[/list]

Lastly, we have added a feature that allows you to navigate quickly between your matches.

 

[h1]This Update Includes:[/h1]

[list]

[*]Quick skip for un-responsive players

[*]Displays turn times, and basic match information

[*] Added in quick invitation use

[*]Declining and Accepting invites in-game

[*]UI improvements – Color coded boards with battalions

[*]Several bug fixes

[/list]

We are constantly looking at ways to improve Regimental Chess. Please feel free to send us any bugs, suggestions or comments to [url=info@regimentalchess.com]info@regimentalchess.com.[/url]

 

To stay informed with the latest news and updates, follows us on [url=http://www.facebook.com/regimentalchess]Facebook[/url].
